name: Illinois River — Chamber Springs Boating Access to WOKA Whitewater Park Canoe-Kayakng Access
gaugeName: Illinois River at Hwy. 16 near Siloam Springs AR (USGS 07195400)
blurb: The upper Illinois River from Chamber Springs to WOKA Whitewater Park on the Oklahoma line (AGFC Upper Illinois River Water Trail).

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Chamber Springs Boating Access: exact agency access pin. Take-out Siloam Springs Kayak Park Access: exact agency access pin. AGFC Upper Illinois River Water Trail: Siloam Springs Kayak Park (Fisher Ford) and WOKA Whitewater Park have Class II+ rapids (carry around to avoid capsizing). Arkansas law: no glass containers in canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in sealed containers, carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat and use floating drink holders; children 12 and under wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: AGFC water-trail distance table.
